objects.title: Feedback Loop Theory in Engineering
objects.content: Feedback loops underpin every adaptive engineering system. A signal is observed, compared against a target, and the gap drives correction. This pattern recurs in control theory, software incident response, and continuous deployment pipelines. Without measurable feedback the system cannot self-correct.

objects.title: Retrospectives as Feedback Mechanism
objects.content: A team retrospective is an explicit feedback loop. Each iteration the team observes outcomes, compares them to intent, and proposes corrections for the next iteration. The retrospective embodies the same observe-compare-correct cycle described in feedback loop theory.

objects.title: Premature Optimization is Evil
objects.content: Knuth's famous warning: premature optimization is the root of all evil in programming. Optimize only after profiling reveals an actual bottleneck. Most programs spend their time in a small fraction of their code.

objects.title: Performance Optimization Patterns
objects.content: Profile first, then optimize the hot path. Common patterns include caching repeated computation, batching IO, and avoiding allocation in tight loops. Optimization without profiling is guesswork.

objects.title: 反饋迴路與系統設計
objects.content: 反饋迴路是任何適應性工程系統的基礎。系統觀察訊號、與目標比對、由差距驅動修正。這個模式出現在控制理論、軟體事件響應、與持續部署流程中。沒有可量測的反饋，系統無法自我修正。

objects.title: 迴路設計中的反饋機制
objects.content: 反饋迴路是適應性工程系統的核心。系統觀察訊號、與目標比對、根據差距進行修正。這個模式出現在控制理論、軟體事件處理、與持續部署管線中。可量測的反饋是系統能夠自我修正的前提。

objects.title: 敏捷開發 Sprint 規劃
objects.content: Sprint 規劃會議在每個迭代開始前舉行。團隊與產品負責人共同決定該 sprint 要交付的 user story。規劃時要考慮容量、故事點估算、與依賴順序。

objects.title: 用戶故事撰寫指南
objects.content: 好的 user story 遵循 As a... I want... So that... 結構。要包含驗收條件，並且小到能在一個 sprint 內完成。避免技術術語，從使用者角度描述價值。
